tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Here comes Bucks at Magic, and the opening tip is where our night begins! The jump ball goes Carter against Turner, and Carter has the springs tonight! Advantage Magic for the opening bucket. And if the Bucks flip the script, Turner is waiting right there to pounce!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Knicks at Pacers, and here's how we see the opening act! Towns and Zubac meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! Oubre is the sneaky finisher on that opening trip!

tickets.name: Ice Breaker
tickets.note: Next up, Grizzlies at Pelicans, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! It starts with Jordan against Stewart at center court, and our money says Jordan gets up there first! Win that tip and the Pelicans are first in line to score. Matkovic is the one we want finishing that first trip down the floor!

tickets.name: Lead the Break
tickets.note: Lights up for Hawks at Bulls, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Okongwu squares up with Smith for the opening tip, and we like Okongwu to control it! That puts the Hawks on the front foot to get on the board first. If Okongwu controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look!

tickets.name: First Touch
tickets.note: Cavaliers and Heat, and the first bucket of this one has our fingerprints all over it! The jump ball pits Allen against Adebayo, a true fifty-fifty! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Heat to cash the first trip! Give Adebayo the tip and he's sprinting to the block. Feed the big man!

tickets.name: Two Points
tickets.note: It's Warriors and Spurs, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! Green has to deal with Wembanyama in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! So the Spurs should get the first crack at it. If the Warriors steal the tip or get the first stop, Green is who we want firing first!

tickets.name: The Starter
tickets.note: Trail Blazers at Kings, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! Clingan and Sabonis meet in the circle, and Clingan has been winning these jumps all season long! That hands the Trail Blazers the first possession, and that's half the battle! Should the Kings grab the first possession, LaVine is our trigger man!
